title: Ur2yung [V2]
status_source_term: Beat Only | Beat Only | CD Quality
description: According to Machinedrum, "Ur2Yung was originally going to be on Vapor City back in 2013, but Kanye wanted it for Yeezus so I held back on releasing it until this year. #AViewOfU". He would also state that he tweeted "just got the craziest news, cant wait to share" some time in 2012, referring to the news that Kanye wanted the song, however he most likely meant 2013 as the timeline doesn't match up. Most likely pre-Rick Rubin, as he was the last producer to work on the album in the last 15 days of production. The instrumental of this version is slightly different to the released instrumental. Later released on A View Of U in 2020. The 2013 version of the instrumental, which is possibly what Ye recorded on, leaked on August 18th 2026.

title: YZY DSRT BT KIDS
description: The YZY DSRT BT features an upper composed of nubuck and suede overlays with mesh underlays for breathability and a reflective pull tab. The rubber outsole provides durability and traction.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 Infant
description: Released on August 24th, 2016, alongside the Yeezy Boost 350 Infant ‘Pirate Black’ 2016 colorway, the Yeezy Boost 350 Infant ‘Turtle Dove’ is an exact replica of the adult model in infant sizes from 5 to 10. The design features a blue-gray/turtle dove Primeknit upper with branded suede patches on the medial sides, patterned rope laces, red accented heel tabs, and a white Boost outsole.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: Kanye West and adidas continued their partnership with the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Butter,’ which hit stores in June 2018. The minimalist silhouette features distinct center stitching on a reverse Primeknit upper, with the signature ‘SPLY-350’ inscription now printed on the interior side. The heel tab remains, finished in a bright yellow hue that matches the knitted upper, rope laces, and Boost-infused midsole.

title: YEEZY 700 V3
description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 ‘Kyanite’ showcases flowing stripes of blue coloring throughout the breathable upper, constructed from monofilament engineered mesh with exoskeletal RPU overlays coated in a glow-in-the-dark finish. Interior bootie construction delivers a snug fit, while a reinforced rubber toe cap provides added durability. The sneaker rides on a lightweight EVA midsole encapsulated in an off-white PU cage, supported by a herringbone rubber outsole.
